dct_title_s: Washington County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol TB; form of individual image numbering: TB-1-[number], TB-2-[number], TB-3-[number], TB-4-[number], or TB-5-[number]."Date of completion 10-14-37" Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
